text.p: Tropical Storm Marco, with 45 mph winds, is stationary at this time, about 140 miles south of Kingston Jamaica. A tropical storm watch continues for Jamaica. Marco is expected to maintain strength and show little motion during the next 18 to 24 hours. Squalls and thunderstorms will threaten boating and shipping. Very heavy rain with Marco remains mostly over water at this time but some of the rain may move into Jamaica and the Dominican Republic during the next day or so, increasing the risk of flash flooding.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
